shared_elements: low-relief carving on weathered grey stone
raised outlines rendered in shallow relief
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings in coarse weathered stone that organise motifs into horizontal registers, and both include disc-like elements and human-referential forms, which is the most concrete correspondence. But A is a single vertical block with abstract, blocky, heavily eroded symbols read as a stacked column, whereas B is a long horizontal frieze of finely modelled, repeated profile figures in procession within an architectural setting — different formats, scales and levels of naturalism.
